title: Hearty Briny Algerian Lamb Wrap
description: A kid-friendly Algerian dish featuring fresh thyme and miso-marinated lamb, wrapped in a corn husk wrap, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This Whole30-friendly recipe is dense and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the miso marinade.
Let the lamb marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Wrap each lamb strip in a corn husk, leaving a small overlap at the seam.
Place the wrapped lamb strips on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the lamb for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Sprinkle chopped fresh thyme over the lamb before serving.
Serve the lamb wraps hot, with additional thyme and lemon wedges on the side.
